Mr. Fanstino Aguilar
On the basis of the total collection and whatever additional
suru the Government may appropriate and assign therefor,
the Committee is empowered to undertake and supervise
the construction of a new "Unang Sigaw" monument in
Balintawak, waiving all existing rules and regulations on
government bids and awards for public constructions in
order that said project may be completed in the most ex-
reditious and convenient manner.
Done in the City of Manila, this 9th day of June, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-two, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the sixth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
